items.headline: AI stocks lift U.S. indexes as oil and Treasury yields retreat
items.summary: U.S. indexes opened higher as gains in AI stocks coincided with falling crude prices and lower Treasury yields.

items.headline: Rothschild initiates CoreWeave at Sell amid credit-market concerns
items.summary: Rothschild & Co. Redburn initiated coverage of CoreWeave with a Sell rating, citing risks that credit markets may be pricing more negatively than AI equities.

items.headline: Rothschild initiates Nebius at Sell
items.summary: Rothschild & Co. Redburn initiated Nebius at Sell and expressed caution about the financing and spending outlook for AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Accenture gains after Anthropic partnership and AI investment plans
items.summary: Accenture was among the stocks highlighted in reporting on AI-led market gains after partnering with Anthropic and committing to invest in AI evaluation.

items.headline: Meta shares rise as AI momentum supports chip and technology stocks
items.summary: Meta was reported among the stronger technology performers as investors returned to AI-related equities while oil and bond yields eased.

items.headline: Marvell highlighted as AI connectivity stock in higher futures session
items.summary: Marvell was identified as a stock in focus during a session in which AI-related equities and semiconductor names advanced.

items.headline: Wall Street approaches record as oil prices and bond yields ease
items.summary: U.S. stocks moved within roughly 1% of their record as oil prices and bond yields reversed some of the prior week's increases.

items.headline: Axios warns AI investment has become increasingly interconnected with the economy
items.summary: The report highlighted concerns that the growing interdependence of AI investment, financing, and the broader economy could amplify the consequences of an AI-sector slowdown.
